entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Mike. How can I help you today?
Hi Mike, I need to return my VeloBand Cadence Sensor. The pulse reading is completely inaccurate and I'd just like to send it back.
I understand. Let me get that sorted out for you right away. Can I get your name and order number, please?
Sure, the name is Alex Chen, order number is VF88-121525-901.
Thank you, Alex. I see your account here... and I see you're a VIP member with us. Thanks so much for your loyalty. Okay, it looks like you received the band about a month ago.
Yes, that's right. Is that going to be an issue?
Oh, no problem at all. You're well within the return window. Our policy allows returns for up to 90 days.
Oh, 90 days? That's great. I was worried I had missed the deadline.
Not at all. I've just processed that return authorization. I'm emailing you a prepaid return label right now. You should see it in your inbox in the next few minutes.
Wow, that was fast. So I just print the label and send it back?

Exactly. Just put the VeloBand back in its original box, attach the label, and you can drop it off at any post office. And as a little thank you for being a VIP, I've also added a $20 credit to your VeloFit account for your next purchase. Is there anything else I can assist with?
No, that's perfect. Thank you so much for making that so easy, Mike.
You're very welcome, Alex. Thanks for calling VeloFit, and have a great rest of your day.
